mapper.sql: id, title, item_type, description, status, priority, start_at, end_at, due_at, all_day, category_id, related_plan_id, location, sort_order, deleted, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_schedule_item WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN priority = 'HIGH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS highPriorityCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inProgressCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedCount FROM sys_schedule_item WHERE deleted = 0 AND status <> 'CANCELLED' AND NOT ( item_type = 'TASK' AND start_at IS NULL AND end_at IS NULL AND due_at IS NULL ) AND COALESCE(start_at, end_at, due_at) IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(start_at, end_at, due_at) <= #{endDate} AND COALESCE(end_at, start_at, due_at) >= #{startDate}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_schedule_item ( title, item_type, description, status, priority, start_at, end_at, due_at, all_day, category_id, related_plan_id, location, sort_order, deleted ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{itemType}, #{description}, #{status}, #{priority}, #{startAt}, #{endAt}, #{dueAt}, #{allDay}, #{categoryId}, #{relatedPlanId}, #{location}, #{sortOrder}, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_schedule_item SET title = #{title}, item_type = #{itemType}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, priority = #{priority}, start_at = #{startAt}, end_at = #{endAt}, due_at = #{dueAt}, all_day = #{allDay}, category_id = #{categoryId}, related_plan_id = #{relatedPlanId}, location = #{location}, sort_order = #{sortOrder} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE sys_schedule_item SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE sys_schedule_item SET related_plan_id = NULL WHERE related_plan_id = #{planId} AND deleted = 0 AND item_type = 'TASK'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_schedule_item WHERE deleted = 0 AND item_type = 'PLAN' AND status <> 'CANCELLED' ORDER BY COALESCE(start_at, create_time) DESC, id DESC
